rules.note: Each figure covers a finished ISO week or calendar month, per app and for all apps together; a count under 10 shows as "<10" (and when only one app is hidden beside a published total, the smallest other app figure is hidden too, so nothing can be subtracted out), and a retention share is published only for a cohort of at least 10 installs.

metrics.title: Weekly active installs
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. Each install reports once per week, so a week still running is a partial count.

metrics.title: New installs
metrics.caveat: Only installs that ran a version with Lifestream and left usage counts on. App Store downloads are the downloads metric.

metrics.title: Purchases
metrics.caveat: First purchases of a subscription and one-time purchases as Apple notifies the ledger; renewals are not counted. Production only.

metrics.title: Refunds
metrics.caveat: Production only; the day Apple told the ledger, not the day of the purchase.

metrics.title: AI requests
metrics.caveat: Chat requests only; image generations are not counted here.

metrics.title: Active subscriptions
metrics.caveat: Production only, counted from the transactions the ledger has; a subscription bought before the ledger existed counts from its first renewal the ledger saw. Every app that ever sold a subscription has a value for every day, zero included.

metrics.title: Monthly active installs
metrics.caveat: Counts installs, not people. A month still running is a partial count.

metrics.title: Week-1 retention
metrics.caveat: The share of a week's new installs that are active again the next week. The period is the install week; a cohort under 10 installs shows "<10", and a value appears once that next week has finished.

metrics.title: Week-4 retention
metrics.caveat: The share of a week's new installs still active four weeks later. The period is the install week; a cohort under 10 installs shows "<10", and a value appears once that fourth week has finished.

apple.source: App Store Connect sales and subscription reports

money.basis: Apple's reported developer proceeds, after Apple's commission and the sales taxes Apple collects, converted at the European Central Bank's reference rate of each day

definitions.title: Downloads
definitions.caveat: First-time downloads of an app as App Store Connect's sales reports count them, on every platform. Redownloads and updates are not counted.

definitions.title: Redownloads
definitions.caveat: Downloads by someone who had the app before, from the same reports.

definitions.title: Paid purchases
definitions.caveat: Every paid transaction the sales reports carry: in-app purchases, subscription starts and renewals, and paid downloads. Free trials and refunds are not counted.

definitions.title: Proceeds (EUR)
definitions.caveat: What Apple reports it owes Midgar for the period's sales, after Apple's commission and the sales taxes Apple collects, net of refunds, each day's amount in each currency converted to euros at the European Central Bank's reference rate of that day (the last published rate on weekends and holidays; the few currencies the ECB does not publish at a recent market rate). An approximation of what Apple pays out, which uses its own rates. Not hidden under 10.

definitions.title: Active subscriptions
definitions.caveat: Paid subscriptions active on the period's last day in App Store Connect's subscription report, which starts later than the sales reports; empty before it.

definitions.title: Countries that downloaded
definitions.caveat: How many App Store countries downloaded at least one app in the period.

definitions.title: Countries that bought
definitions.caveat: How many App Store countries made at least one paid purchase in the period.
